aggregation: All required indices must be assessable; otherwise UNASSESSED. Among assessable indices the more defensive state wins: correction > pressure > confirmed uptrend.
notes: Independent deterministic model inspired by published IBD concepts, not official IBD data or an exact reproduction.
Fixed thresholds are our versioned implementation choices. No watchlist/leader inputs, discretionary stalling days, or return-based validation.
No uptrend is bootstrapped: an observed correction and subsequent valid rally/FTD are required to confirm an uptrend.

Correction starts at a fresh two-session 50DMA break plus >=8% drawdown from the 21-session high, a fresh 200DMA break, or rally/FTD low invalidation. Initial state may also be seeded by an existing price downtrend. A rally can confirm while still below moving averages.
Missing/non-positive volume is unavailable, never zero distribution days. Price trend is shown separately.
Distribution events expire after 25 sessions or a subsequent intraday high >= 5% above the event close; FTD resets active counts.
